evals.prompt: Can you review the agent instructions in CLAUDE.md and the helper subagent in .claude/agents/helper.md? I want to know how well they're written.
evals.expected_output: Two reports, one per file, each header naming the file's kind: CLAUDE.md standing, helper.md delegated (T-1, SI-1).
expectations: The report on CLAUDE.md has the header line 'Review: CLAUDE.md (standing persona)'
The report on .claude/agents/helper.md has the header line 'Review: .claude/agents/helper.md (delegated persona)'
The standing file's report comes before the delegated file's

evals.prompt: review .claude/agents/helper.md for me, the subagent keeps ignoring its rules and I don't know why
evals.expected_output: One report on helper.md: the stars and the total first, then the quoted lines, the checks, the ratings and the formula, and the no-prediction sentence (T-4, SI-4).
expectations: The report's first line is five star places with the number in brackets, such as '★★½☆☆ (2.5)', and its second is 'Total: x out of y'
Every item under 'Lines that lowered the score' quotes a numbered line and names its question
Every check under 'Checks' shows 'yes 1' or 'no 0', or says it is not scored
Every rating under 'Ratings' shows its point as 'n of 6' with its word, such as '3 of 6   about half the time', or says it is not rated
'Lines that lowered the score' comes before 'Checks', and 'Checks' before 'Ratings' and the formula
The report holds the sentence 'A score does not predict how the agent will behave. The quoted lines are what to act on.'
The report holds an item quoting 'tools: Read, Grep, Edit' against line 9, 'Never edit files; report what you find in a list.', under 'Bound parts agree with the prose'
The output holds no replacement wording for any line and no verdict word (pass, fail, approve, block, severity) outside the quoted lines

evals.prompt: Please review every persona file in this repository and give me the scores.
evals.expected_output: A summary and five reports; the project's files are unchanged (T-9, SI-9).
expectations: The SHA-256 manifest of the project after the run equals the manifest before it, file list included (checked by script: make_fixtures.py compare)

The output holds only the summary and, for each file, the stars, the total, the header, the quoted lines, the checks, the ratings, the fit part when neighbours were supplied, the formula and the closing sentences
The output offers no replacement wording and compares with no other version of any file

evals.prompt: Score CLAUDE.md against the persona review questions and show me how the total was worked out.
evals.expected_output: A report whose printed total and stars follow from its checks and ratings by the stated formula (T-10, SI-10).
expectations: Saved to a file, the report makes 'report.py verify' exit 0 (checked by script)
The formula is printed with the report's own x and y: 'Formula: each check counts 1 or 0 and each rating its points, x out of y.'
The stars line 'Stars: x ÷ y × 5 = s, to the nearest half star.' is printed, and s rounds to the stars at the top

evals.prompt: Check all the agent instructions in this project, whatever harness they're for, and tell me which ones need the most work.
evals.expected_output: A summary of five files, not the README, ordered from the lowest score, each report beneath (T-11, SI-11).
expectations: The summary lists exactly CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .claude/agents/helper.md, .claude/agents/doc-writer.md and .cursor/rules/style.mdc
README.md and CHANGELOG.md are not reviewed
The summary is ordered from the lowest total as a share (x ÷ y), ties by path
Each file's report follows the summary, in the summary's order

evals.prompt: Review only the subagents in .claude/agents/ and nothing else.
evals.expected_output: Reports on the two agent files and no others (T-11, SI-11).
expectations: Exactly two files are reviewed: .claude/agents/doc-writer.md and .claude/agents/helper.md
